errors.evidence: The chart contains two lines: a solid data line and a dotted trendline. The description incorrectly states there is only one line.

The description attributes a dotted style ("пунктиран стил") to the line, but then proceeds to describe the path of the solid line. It confuses the style of the trendline with the path of the data line.
The solid line begins at approximately 0.345 in 2009. The value 0.36 corresponds to the starting point of the dotted trendline, not the data line being described.
The line does not decrease to 2012. It dips slightly in 2010/2011 and then rises to a value of approximately 0.355 in 2012. The description of the trend and the value for 2012 are both incorrect.
The value of the line in 2016 is approximately 0.335, not 0.32.

errors.text_span: последвано от намаление до точката (2019, при приблизително 0,28)
errors.evidence: This is an oversimplification of the trend. The line decreases from 2016 to a minimum in 2018 (at approx. 0.27) and then rises to approx. 0.28 in 2019. The description misses the minimum point in 2018 and the subsequent increase.
The description mentions the equation 'y = -0,007x + 0,3656' but fails to explain that it corresponds to the dotted trendline, which is a key feature of the graph.
The text with the equation is a simple text label, not a "horizontal text". While not a major error, it is an imprecise structural description.
